rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: runner shutdown
rules.pattern: runner has received a shutdown signal|hosted runner lost communication|runner .* lost connection

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: out of disk
rules.pattern: No space left on device|ENOSPC

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: cancelled/killed
rules.pattern: The operation was canceled|exit code 143|exit code 137|Killed$|Out of memory|OOMKilled

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: network unreachable
rules.pattern: Could not resolve host|Temporary failure in name resolution|Connection timed out|TLS handshake timeout|network is unreachable

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: rate limit / 5xx
rules.pattern: 429 Too Many Requests|toomanyrequests|rate limit exceeded|503 Service Unavailable|502 Bad Gateway|HttpError: Service Unavailable

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: action download
rules.pattern: Failed to download action|Unable to resolve action|Set up job failed

rules.label: dependency
rules.name: npm 404/resolve
rules.pattern: npm ERR! code (E404|ERESOLVE|ETARGET)|npm ERR! 404|ERESOLVE unable to resolve|yarn error Couldn't find package|No matching version found

rules.label: dependency
rules.name: pip no distribution
rules.pattern: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement|No matching distribution found|ResolutionImpossible|conflicting dependencies

rules.label: dependency
rules.name: maven/gradle resolve
rules.pattern: Could not resolve (dependencies|all files|com\.|org\.)|Cannot resolve [a-z]+\.[a-z.]+:|Could not find artifact|Failed to collect dependencies

rules.label: dependency
rules.name: go/cargo module
rules.pattern: reading .*go\.mod|go: .*@v[0-9.]+: .*(404|410)|failed to select a version for|no matching package named|checksum mismatch|SECURITY ERROR

rules.label: dependency
rules.name: lockfile drift
rules.pattern: lockfile .*(out of date|needs to be updated)|npm ci can only install packages when|package-lock.json.* not in sync|ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE|Cannot install with "frozen-lockfile"

rules.label: flaky_test
rules.name: timeouts in tests
rules.pattern: Exceeded timeout of \d+ ?ms|Async callback was not invoked within|TimeoutError: Waiting for|Test timeout of \d+ms exceeded|(test|spec)\S* .*timed out after \d+

rules.label: flaky_test
rules.name: retries/reruns
rules.pattern: \bRERUN\b|Retry(ing)? \d/\d for test|retrying test|\bflaky\b|Attempt \d of \d failed|failed on attempt

rules.label: flaky_test
rules.name: port/connection races
rules.pattern: EADDRINUSE|ECONNRESET|socket hang up|ECONNREFUSED 127\.0\.0\.1|Element is not clickable|stale element reference|race condition

rules.label: real_bug
rules.name: compile error
rules.pattern: error TS\d+:|error\[E\d+\]|SyntaxError:|cannot find symbol|undefined reference to|error: expected|compilation failed|Compilation error|cannot be resolved to a type

rules.label: real_bug
rules.name: assertion failure
rules.pattern: AssertionError|assert .* == |Expected: .*Received:|expected .* to (equal|be|deeply equal)|FAILED .*::test_.* - |--- FAIL: |Assertion failed

rules.label: real_bug
rules.name: runtime exception
rules.pattern: NullPointerException|NameError:|TypeError:|ReferenceError:|panic: runtime error|IndexError:|KeyError:|AttributeError:|Traceback \(most recent call last\)

rules.label: real_bug
rules.name: lint/type check
rules.pattern: \d+ problems? \(\d+ errors?|mypy: .* error|ruff (check|format)\.*Failed|would reformat|files? would be reformatted|flake8.*:\d+:\d+: [A-Z]\d+|eslint.*error|Found \d+ errors? in

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: artifact not found
rules.pattern: Unable to download artifact|Artifact not found for name

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: git push conflict
rules.pattern: failed to push some refs|could not apply [0-9a-f]+\.\.\.

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: auth / secrets
rules.pattern: Authorization error|gated repo|401 Unauthorized|401 Client Error|Bad credentials|Resource not accessible by integration|github-token" length

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: oom / signal kill
rules.pattern: exited with 137|exited with 143|Worker exited unexpectedly with signal

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: transient syscall/network
rules.pattern: EINTR|EAI_AGAIN|ETIMEDOUT|Connection refused \(after|Failed to retrieve new repository metadata|Access to requested URL is forbidden

rules.label: infrastructure
rules.name: action timeout
rules.pattern: action .* has timed out after \d+ minutes

rules.label: dependency
rules.name: dependabot
rules.pattern: Dependabot encountered|dependency_file_not_parseable|updater encountered one or more errors

rules.label: dependency
rules.name: missing python module
rules.pattern: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named

rules.label: dependency
rules.name: vulnerable dependency
rules.pattern: govulncheck|Vulnerability #\d+|Server panic via missing authority

rules.label: real_bug
rules.name: lint / format tool
rules.pattern: Imports are incorrectly sorted|Flow failed for|Lint failed|Double quote to prevent|Code style issues found

rules.label: real_bug
rules.name: test failure lines
rules.pattern: Test suite failed to run|^\s*FAILED .*::|--- FAIL: |test failed, to rerun|\d+ failed, \d+ passed|Failed Tests|Executed \d+ of \d+ ERROR

rules.label: real_bug
rules.name: denied warnings / compiler
rules.pattern: warnings are denied|\[-Werror=|all warnings being treated as errors|Bootstrap failed|Found \d+ errors?|error: .* is not present in stub

rules.label: flaky_test
rules.name: process pool / worker crash in tests
rules.pattern: BrokenProcessPool|panic: test timed out after|test timed out after \d+m
